deployments_detail.use: Vertex AI for aircraft-manufacturing material demand forecasting (Enami factory), significant waste reduction
Drone AI autonomy (with US Shield AI), dev completed in 8 weeks; company-wide generative AI

TOMONI intelligent-solutions suite for power plants: uses AI/machine learning for predictive and prescriptive analytics, automated optimization of operating parameters, and condition-based/remote O&M. Deployed at existing and new power plants worldwide, validated at the T-Point 2 demonstration plant. [Mitsubishi Power (MHI)]

AIRIS onboard AI-based object detector for satellites: performs in-orbit object (e.g., vessel) detection on Earth-observation imagery using a space-grade AI processor (SOISOC4), with selective downlink and in-orbit model retraining. Scheduled to launch aboard the RAISE-4 demonstration satellite in FY2025. [MHI (with Tokyo University of Science; JAXA demonstration)]

MaiDAS: next-generation AI-based remote monitoring and highly-automated operation support system for waste-to-energy (incineration) plants, optimizing evaporation rate and exhaust-gas concentration while protecting critical equipment. In joint research/verification with the City of Yokohama (four-day automated-operation test). [Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Environmental & Chemical Engineering (MHIEC)]

Business alliance with Preferred Networks to jointly develop Japan-made AI for mission-critical machinery in social infrastructure and national security, embedding PFN's PLaMo generative-AI foundation model, MN-Core AI processors and PFCP cloud platform into MHI products for autonomous operation, predictive maintenance and crisis management. Alliance/capital agreement targeted within FY2026. [Preferred Networks (PLaMo, MN-Core, PFCP)]

Autonomous-flight AI testing under MHI's ARMD (Affordable Rapid-prototyping Mitsubishi-Drone) initiative using Shield AI's Hivemind autonomy software; two live flight demonstrations in Gunma, Japan, where the aircraft autonomously demonstrated reinforcement learning and trained behaviors while tracking a virtual air vehicle. Integration-to-flight in under 60 days (proof of concept). [Shield AI (Hivemind)]

Joint development with Yokogawa of an AI-enabled automatic inspection system for offshore facilities, using the EX ROVR explosion-proof inspection robot plus an AI application that converts robot-acquired image and sound data to identify and predict hazards. In proof-of-concept testing (project started June 2022). [Yokogawa (joint); MHI EX ROVR robot]

Generative AI plus voice recognition automating 24-hour on-call after-sales customer support for machinery products in the US market (Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Machinery Systems), suggesting responses and automating transcription/call registration under the ΣSynX brand. [none]
deployments_detail.value: Recorded calls more than tripled from 150 to 500 per month

deployments_detail.use: exaBase IR Assistant: a task-specialized generative-AI service adopted by MHI's Investor Relations department (and related divisions such as general affairs, legal, corporate planning, accounting) to streamline IR work and enable higher-value disclosure activities. [Exa Enterprise AI (ExaWizards)]

Internal 'AI Workspace' for employees built on Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock Knowledge Bases, providing RAG-based internal knowledge search and document summarization. Launched April 2026; exceeded 2,000 active users within two weeks and logged 15,000 chat interactions. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock Knowledge Bases); implementation partner Serverworks]
deployments_detail.value: 2,000+ active users in two weeks; 15,000 chat interactions

deployments_detail.use: TOMONI TALK (internally 'MHI-GPT'): an internal generative-AI chat assistant for the power-plant business, using RAG over proprietary plant data for document summarization/translation, code generation, troubleshooting and internal information retrieval. Deployed July 2023, ~200-300 active users per day. [Microsoft (Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search)]

In-house-developed ticket/inquiry management system consolidating customer inquiries, built with AWS (Next.js frontend, Amazon RDS, AWS Lambda) as part of MHI's in-sourcing of internal systems; in production handling up to nearly 50 inquiries daily. [AWS (Lambda, RDS); partner Serverworks]
deployments_detail.value: Up to nearly 50 inquiries handled daily
